symptom: _garble_ratio full-text check mirrors _tree_is_garbled — windowed ratio is dead code, always returns 1.0. In classify_verdict, _tree_is_garbled(structure) (line 1559) calls _is_garbled_blob+_has_sparse_mojibake on _flatten_tree_text(structure). When True, _garble_ratio(flat_text) (line 1572) evaluates the SAME checks on the SAME text, so full_garbled=1.0 and max(1.0, window_ratio)=1.0 always. The windowed ratio (designed for fine-grained measurement) never influences the result. For the SLA doc, _has_sparse_mojibake fires on the full concatenated text because _flatten_tree_text joins titles+text with NO separator (line 555-565), creating artificial Arabic-Latin-Arabic glued patterns at node boundaries. The doc is at the 2% threshold boundary — minor extraction differences between runs push it over/under, flipping full_garbled between 0.0 and 1.0 (PASS vs MARGINAL with ratio=1.00).

Additionally, _flatten_tree_text should insert a space or newline separator between concatenated parts to prevent artificial glued-script patterns.

symptom: Garble gate blind to non-PUA Arabic single-letter fragment decomposition; bidi coherence enforcement disabled. _is_garbled_blob has no heuristic for single-letter Arabic fragment patterns (letters separated by spaces, e.g. Arabic word decomposed into individual letters with spaces between them). This is a common PDF text-layer extraction failure. _check_bidi_coherence was wired into validate_tree by RFC-030 D5 but runs in audit-only mode (BIDI_COHERENCE_ENFORCE defaults to false, line 1288). It logs warnings but does not affect the stored verdict. Combined: سياسة حوكمة passes the gate with stored verdict PASS despite 79% of nodes containing garbled single-letter fragments and RTL word-order reversal, because neither pattern is detected by the enforced checks.

suggested_fix: (a) Add a single-letter Arabic fragment detection heuristic to _is_garbled_blob: when >50% of Arabic words in a blob are single characters (excluding particles like و), flag as garbled. (b) Promote BIDI_COHERENCE_ENFORCE from audit-only to enforced (default true) after reviewing the accumulated audit logs for false-positive rate. (c) Add the single-letter-fragment check to _garble_check_nodes per-node inspection as well.

symptom: The incremental ingest+score pipeline (corpus-ingest-score.js) lacks retry logic in its Stage 2 (fetch metrics) when reading MinIO artifacts. The minio_helper.py script has zero retry on S3 NoSuchKey or transient network errors. When a transient MinIO read failure occurs between Stage 1 (process) completing and Stage 2 (fetch) reading, the document gets a permanent ERROR verdict despite the artifacts existing in MinIO. The converter child writes synchronously (save_doc then save_doc_meta via put_object) before emitting its success JSON, so the write IS committed before Stage 1 reports success. The gap is in the read path: minio_helper.py cmd_meta and cmd_tree make single-attempt reads with no retry-with-backoff, and the Stage 2 agent prompt contains no instruction to retry on failure.

suggested_fix: Add retry-with-backoff (3 attempts, 2s/4s/8s delays) to minio_helper.py cmd_meta and cmd_tree for transient S3 errors (NoSuchKey, ConnectionError, network timeouts). Additionally, add a retry instruction to the Stage 2 agent prompt in corpus-ingest-score.js: 'If minio_helper.py returns NoSuchKey, wait 5 seconds and retry up to 3 times before concluding the artifacts are missing.'

symptom: _ARTICLE_RE regex in converters.py:226 requires 'Article \d+' (digits immediately after space) but UAE/English legal docs use parenthesized form 'Article (N)'. _segment_label returns [] for these headings, so _containment_depths returns None, and _relevel_by_containment leaves all Article headings at their original flat level. The _OVERSIZED_ORDINAL_RE in helpers.py:1798 correctly handles parens ('Art(?:icle|\.)?\s+\(?\s*') but this only fires in split_oversized_leaf_nodes for already-built nodes >50k chars - it cannot help when md_to_tree already produced many small flat nodes.

The _OVERSIZED_ORDINAL_RE in helpers.py:1798 correctly handles parens ('Art(?:icle|\.)?\s+\(?\s*') but this only fires in split_oversized_leaf_nodes for already-built nodes >50k chars - it cannot help when md_to_tree already produced many small flat nodes.
suggested_fix: Widen _ARTICLE_RE to accept optional parentheses: r'^(?:Art(?:icle|\.)\s+\(?\s*\d+|§\s*\(?\s*\d+)'. This makes _segment_label extract the number from 'Article (47)' as label ['47'], enabling containment-based depth assignment.

symptom: German AHB documents use clause-level numbering (e.g. 'Ziffer 1', numbered paragraphs) that Docling does not detect as section headers - they stay as plain prose text. Unlike Arabic structural markers which have _inject_arabic_structural_headings to promote plain-text markers to headings, there is no equivalent injection for German clause patterns ('Ziffer N', 'Ziff. N') or for English 'Article (N)' patterns when Docling misses them entirely. The heading-depth recovery chain (_relevel_by_containment/_relevel_by_numbering/_relevel_by_outline) can only re-level EXISTING headings, not create new ones from prose.

suggested_fix: Symbol-cell recovery requires either (a) per-cell OCR fallback on empty cells that neighbor non-empty cells in the same table, or (b) a VLM-based table re-extraction pass for tables with empty_cell_ratio > threshold. Both are outside the current Docling pipeline. RFC-010 Gap 6b already documents this as unfixable at the pageindex layer.

symptom: RFC-022 B2 Part A (extension-based content_class='image_standalone' override for _IMAGE_EXTS files after route_and_extract_flat) was marked complete in task tracker but never implemented in client.py. Bare .jpg files go through route_and_extract_flat which classifies them as flat_prose/flat_mixed (OCR text creates prose blocks, not all role='image'), so the all(b.get('role')=='image') check at line 1606 fails. Without image_standalone content_class, classify_verdict hits the flat_prose promotion gate where 489 chars < 500 MIN_IMAGE_PROMOTED_CHARS char floor, yielding MARGINAL/image_enrichment_promoted_below_char_floor instead of routing through _classify_image_verdict (which has no char floor).
